The `tcp_chat` repository implements a Python-based chat system consisting of three modules and a test suite managed with `pytest`. Central to the system is `protocol.py::protocol.py`, which defines the line protocol using commands and length-prefixed frames for communication. Network operations are split between `server.py::server.py`, a threaded TCP chat server that assigns one thread per client to manage unique nicknames and message broadcasts, and `client.py::client.py`, which provides the command-line chat interface.
